info.title: Get headless return eligibility
info.description:
This is only for headless merchants. Please see the implementation guide for more details.

## Overview For partners and merchants who want to keep their own return flow, but use Happy Returns to manage return shipments across various drop-off methods. This endpoint evaluates which headless return methods are available based on the contents of the return and responds with eligibility and available locations. View the implementation guide for more details. ## Authentication Partners can authenticate for this endpoint by following the steps here: API set up.

/return_eligibility.description:
This endpoint will take a JSON body defined below and determine the eligibility of the return for configured dropoff methods. It will determine the eligibility for a return bar and/or in-store locations based on the configuration.

If a return is eligible for one of the methods, then it may provide the nearby location details for the order shipment zipcode.

If a return is ineligible for one the methods, then it will provide one or more validation failures for the dropoff method.

parameters.name: X-Hr-Apikey
parameters.description: A partner’s API key. The partner must be authorized by Happy Returns to check return eligibility for  headless returns. Contact Happy Returns to grant permission.

200.description: Successful response for return eligibility request

401.description: Error message sent when partner does not have permission or missing/invalid X-Hr-Apikey

post.description: Checks eligibility for a return for headless retailers. https://partner.happyreturns.com/return_eligibility

retailer_id.description: The identifier of the retailer for the returning items. This needs to match an already existing retailer, cannot be arbitrary.

email.description: The email address on the order for sending email confirmations for the return

return_fee.description: Return fee amount with currency code

shipping_method_id.description: Shipping method ID of the retailer

mail_destination_address.description: Mail Destination address of the retailer

ups_dap_child_account_number.description: Retailer’s UPS account for applying partner DAP rates. Use only if enrolled in UPS Digital Access Program.

id.description: Unique ID for the line item the purchase came from. Can also use the SKU - does not need to be unique in the return

order_number.description: Order number of the order the purchase belongs to.

external_rma_id.description: The unique identifier for the return generated by the retailer's or partner's internal systems.

price.description: The price of the product with currency, invalid format will be ignored.

images.description: Images used to identify the purchase being returned

when.description: The date when the order the purchase belongs to was placed. This date is used to determine whether the order is inside the return window (if the return window is managed by Happy Returns).

details.description: Additional details that can be provided about the purchase

display.description: The display values for the product, such as Color, Size, Material, Fitting, etc. that distinguishes this product from other products. This is displayed to identify the product being returned.

reason.description: The reason the customer is returning the purchase

refund_methods_offered.description:
Can be one or more from the following `refund`, `store credit`, `exchange - same price point` or `exchange - upsell`
`refund` - shopper receives a refund to their original form of payment
`store credit` - shopper receives a refund in the form of store credit or e-gift card
`exchange - same price point` - shopper receives an even exchange for a similar item
`exchange - upsell` - shopper receives different price point exchange typically shopping for new/unrelated items

sku.description: The SKU of the product, used for display and reporting.

upc.description: The UPC of the product, if available to use for display and reporting.

product_id.description: A product ID is a unique identifier for a product in the purchase.

serialNmber.description: A serial number is a unique identifier for the product in the purchase

weight.description: Weight of the product without the unit (Must supply `weight_unit` along with it, otherwise it will be ignored)

weightUnit.description: Unit of the weight must be lb, oz, g, kg (Must supply `weight` along with it, otherwise it will be ignored)

label.description: The display label for coupons like "Promotions"

value.description: The display value for coupons like "$10 off your qualifying in-store purchase of $40 or more"

address1.description: Shipping address line 1 for the customer

address2.description: Shipping address line 2 for the customer

latitude.description: Shipping latitude coordinate for the customer

longitude.description: Shipping longitude coordinate for the customer

country_code.description: Shipping country 2 letter ISO code for the customer

province_code.description: Shipping province/state code for the customer

zip_code.description: The Zip Code of the order’s shipping address

phone.description: Phone number of the retailer's destination

address1.description: Destination address line 1 for the retailer

address2.description: Destination address line 2 for the retailer

country_code.description: Destination country 2 letter ISO code for the retailer

province_code.description: Destination province/state code for the retailer

zip_code.description: The Zip Code of the retailer's mail destination address (ex: 90401 or 90401-1234)

id.description: Dropoff method id of `return-bar`, `in-store`, `mail`, `mail-nolabel`, or `mail-nobox-nolabel` (Defaults to `return-bar` if not specified).

eligible.description: Whether the return is eligible for the current dropoff method.

eligibilityError.description:
Any eligibility errors for the current dropoff method. Only sent if `eligible = false`.

Here are some of the expected eligibility errors.

For Return Bar Returns:
  • This return is not eligible for Return Bar drop off as it contains more than 9 item(s).
  • This return is not eligible for Return Bar drop off as it contains high value item(s).
  • This return is not eligible for Return Bar drop off as no locations are available for the shopper.
  • This return is not eligible for Return Bar drop off.
For In-Store Returns:
  • This return is not eligible for In Store drop off.
For Mail Returns:
  • This return is not eligible for Mail drop off.
  • Missing or Invalid Shipping Address.
  • Missing return shipment shipping options. Returned when there are no shipping options configured for the retailer and dropoff method.
For Mail No Label Returns:
  • This return is not eligible for Mail No Label drop off.
  • Missing or Invalid Shipping Address.
  • Missing return shipment shipping options. Returned when there are no shipping options configured for the retailer and dropoff method.
For Mail No Box No Label Returns:
  • Mail no box no label dropoff method is ineligible when return bar is available.
  • This return is not eligible for Mail No Box No Label drop off.
